quests.title: The Rational Number Realm Adventure
quests.description: Enter the sophisticated Rational Number Realm and master the art of rational numbers!

story.introduction: The Rational Number Realm is a place where numbers can be expressed as fractions! King Rational needs your help to organize his kingdom and defeat the Irrational Invaders!

steps.title: Rational Identification Academy
steps.narrative: King Rational trains you to identify true rational numbers. Not all numbers can enter this exclusive realm!

problem.question: Which of these numbers is rational?
problem.explanation: Excellent identification! 3/7 is rational because it can be written as p/q where p and q are integers and q ≠ 0. The others are irrational!

steps.title: Decimal Expansion Laboratory
steps.narrative: Explore the Decimal Laboratory where rational numbers reveal their decimal secrets! Some terminate, others repeat forever!

problem.question: What type of decimal expansion does 1/4 have?
problem.explanation: Perfect analysis! 1/4 = 0.25, which terminates (ends). Rational numbers either terminate or repeat in their decimal form!

steps.title: Operations Battlefield
steps.narrative: Master the battlefield where rational numbers fight using addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division!

problem.question: Calculate: 2/3 + 1/6 = ?
problem.explanation: Battle victory! Find common denominator: 2/3 = 4/6, so 4/6 + 1/6 = 5/6. You've mastered rational number operations!

steps.title: Defeat the Irrational Invader
steps.narrative: The ultimate challenge! The Irrational Invader threatens the Rational Realm. Use all your rational number knowledge to defend the kingdom!

problem.question: The Irrational Invader claims that 0.333... (repeating) is irrational. Prove him wrong!
problem.explanation: Kingdom saved! 0.333... = 1/3, which is a fraction (p/q form), making it rational! Repeating decimals are actually rational numbers in disguise!

quests.title: The Linear Equation Detective Agency
quests.description: Join the elite detective agency that solves mysteries using linear equations!

story.introduction: The Linear Equation Detective Agency handles the toughest mathematical mysteries! Detective Algebra needs your help to solve cases where unknown values hide behind mathematical clues!

steps.title: The Case of the Missing Number
steps.narrative: Your first case: A number has gone missing from an equation! Use your detective skills to find it.

problem.question: Solve for x: 3x + 7 = 22
problem.explanation: Case solved! Subtract 7 from both sides: 3x = 15, then divide by 3: x = 5. The missing number has been found!

steps.title: Word Problem Investigation
steps.narrative: Real-world mysteries need mathematical solutions! Translate word problems into equations to crack the case.

problem.question: Mystery: A shopkeeper sold 3 times as many apples as oranges. If he sold 15 apples, how many oranges did he sell?
problem.explanation: Mystery solved! If apples = 3 × oranges, and apples = 15, then 15 = 3 × oranges, so oranges = 15 ÷ 3 = 5!

steps.title: The Age Puzzle Challenge
steps.narrative: Solve the famous age puzzles that have stumped detectives for years! Use algebra to unlock the secrets of time.

problem.question: Sarah is 3 years older than Tom. If Sarah is 15 years old, how old is Tom?
problem.explanation: Age mystery solved! If Sarah = Tom + 3, and Sarah = 15, then 15 = Tom + 3, so Tom = 15 - 3 = 12 years old!

steps.title: Showdown with the Equation Master
steps.narrative: The ultimate detective challenge! The Equation Master has created the most complex linear equation mystery. Solve it to become the agency's top detective!

problem.question: Final case: 2(x + 3) = 3x - 1. Find the value of x!
problem.explanation: Master Detective achievement unlocked! Expand: 2x + 6 = 3x - 1, rearrange: 6 + 1 = 3x - 2x, so 7 = x. Case closed!

quests.title: The Quadrilateral Architect Guild
quests.description: Join the elite guild of architects who design amazing structures using four-sided shapes!

story.introduction: The Quadrilateral Architect Guild builds the most beautiful and stable structures in the world! Master Architect Euclid will teach you the secrets of four-sided shapes!

steps.title: Parallelogram Construction Site
steps.narrative: Learn to build with parallelograms! These special quadrilaterals have amazing properties that make structures strong and beautiful.

problem.question: What special property do parallelograms have?
options: Opposite sides are parallel and equal
problem.correct_answer: Opposite sides are parallel and equal
problem.explanation: Architectural mastery! Parallelograms have opposite sides that are both parallel and equal in length. This makes them perfect for stable structures!

steps.title: Rectangle Blueprint Design
steps.narrative: Design perfect rectangular structures! Rectangles are everywhere in architecture because of their special properties.

problem.question: A rectangular garden has length 12m and width 8m. What is its area?
problem.explanation: Perfect blueprint! Area of rectangle = length × width = 12 × 8 = 96 square meters. Your garden design is mathematically perfect!

steps.title: Rhombus Diamond Workshop
steps.narrative: Create beautiful diamond-shaped structures using rhombuses! These special parallelograms have all sides equal.

problem.question: What makes a rhombus special among parallelograms?
problem.explanation: Diamond-level understanding! A rhombus is a parallelogram where all four sides are equal in length, like a diamond shape!

steps.title: Become the Quadrilateral Master Architect
steps.narrative: The ultimate architectural challenge! Design a complex structure using all types of quadrilaterals to prove your mastery!

problem.question: Which quadrilateral has all sides equal AND all angles equal to 90 degrees?
problem.explanation: Master Architect status achieved! A square is the perfect quadrilateral - it's both a rectangle (90° angles) AND a rhombus (equal sides)!
